tax.proved_formula_identity: taxable_income = EBT + fiscal_reintegration = (EBIT - senior_interest - shl_interest) + shl_interest = EBIT - senior_interest (when thin_cap=False, rows 57 and 58 = 0, fiscal_reintegration = full SHL)
tax.proved_cit_formula: CIT = MAX(taxable_profit[N-1] + taxable_profit[N], 0) * rate in even-indexed periods only (MOD(period_index, 2) = 0) for operating periods (period_index > 0)
tax.proved_lcf_window: LCF opening balance = SUMIF of negative taxable incomes in a rolling B36-period window (B36=5 periods, NOT 5 years)
tax.proved_thin_cap: Thin Cap = BS!G45 = False for all Oborovo periods
tax.proved_atad: ATAD rows 57/58 = 0 for all Oborovo periods (conditional on thin_cap=False); fiscal reintegration = 100% of SHL interest
